notablePrerequisites: At least eight of your ten sticker sheets have a name sicker with four unique vowels.
description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing _____ Goblin, choosing any target.
Mortuary triggers, putting _____ Goblin on top of your library and returning any stickers on it to your sticker sheets.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment triggers, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Cast _____ Goblin from the top of your library by paying {2}{R}.
_____ Goblin enters the battlefield, getting a name sticker and adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
